problem_statement:
Ask sync swallows a failed paper-twin upload and ship waits it out as "eventual consistency"

After a ship, ask-index drift stayed at 156 of 157. Workers Logs showed `ask twin upload failed publications/10-1128-mra-01077-21.md AiSearchInternalError: unable_to_connect_to_ai_search`, a transient. The twin upload loop in `app/lib/search/ask.server.ts` logged the error and carried on, the converge read-back came up one short, and ship kept polling as if the index were still catching up. A write that had simply failed was reported as lag, and the drift never cleared.

Expected:
- Move the loop into a pure, injectable module `app/lib/search/ask-twins.mjs` exporting `TWIN_ATTEMPTS` (3), `withRetry(fn, { attempts, backoffMs, sleep })` (pauses between tries, doubling each time, e.g. 100 then 200; rethrows the last error) and `uploadTwins(twins, { fetchText, upload, log, sleep })` for `twins` of `{ key, path }`.
- Each twin's fetch and upload are retried; a transient failure that later succeeds lands normally.
- A twin that still fails is returned as `{ key, error }` in `failed`, with `error` like `AiSearchInternalError: unable_to_connect_to_ai_search`, logged once, and still listed in `keys` (so the prune never deletes the copy already indexed). The other twins still upload.
- `askSyncReport` (app/lib/operator/sync-report.mjs) accepts an optional `failed` list, returns it, and is never `converged` while it is non-empty, even when counts agree; `askSyncSummary` then begins `ASK UPLOAD FAILED for N key(s)` and names the keys. Ship and the admin sync button should report named failures instead of polling.
fail_to_pass: node --test --test-name-pattern="refuses convergence on a failed key" test/ask-twins.test.mjs
node --test --test-name-pattern="cannot be fetched is retried" test/ask-twins.test.mjs
